spec.ticket_text:
We need an org-wide issue list: GET /issues returns the caller's org's issues across all
projects. The old reporting client already reads every issue through GET /v1/issues
(app/api/legacy_v1.py and services.legacy), so a lot of the query code exists.

Filters, all optional and combined with AND: status (open|in_progress|done), priority
(low|medium|high), assignee_id, project_id, and q (1-100 characters, case-insensitive substring of
the title). Deleted issues and issues of archived projects are excluded. A project_id or assignee_id
that is not in the caller's org gives 404 not_found; an invalid value gives 422 validation_error. Any
role may read. Items are IssueOut, in the usual cursor-paginated list envelope.

Spec: docs/features/f1.md.
